capabilities.name: Canonical concept to runtime registry
capabilities.outcome: Every concept is traceable from source through runtime, tests and telemetry.
capabilities.nextAction: Run the clone audit and adjudicate every ambiguous match.

capabilities.name: Module contract and lifecycle governance
capabilities.outcome: Every module declares ownership, dependencies, contracts, migrations, health and lifecycle.
capabilities.nextAction: Populate canonical module records from repository evidence.

capabilities.name: Unified identity and session authority
capabilities.outcome: One identity contract serves login, refresh, MFA, recovery, revocation and protected APIs.
capabilities.nextAction: Reconcile all auth implementations and prove one end-to-end token contract.

capabilities.name: Contextual authorization
capabilities.outcome: Server-enforced role and policy decisions protect every consequential action.
capabilities.nextAction: Create endpoint authorization inventory and negative tests.

capabilities.name: Canonical data ownership and lineage
capabilities.outcome: Every entity and metric has one source of truth, owner, retention rule and lineage.
capabilities.nextAction: Execute migrations in a disposable database and reconcile schema ownership.

capabilities.name: Versioned API contract standard
capabilities.outcome: APIs use consistent validation, errors, idempotency and versioning.
capabilities.nextAction: Generate route catalogue and measure conformance.

capabilities.name: Durable workflow orchestration
capabilities.outcome: Consequential journeys enforce transitions, approvals, timers, retry, compensation and audit evidence.
capabilities.nextAction: Implement the professional workflow contracts in workflow-catalog.json.

capabilities.name: Unified ERP control system
capabilities.outcome: Operational transactions post auditable accounting, tax, inventory and reconciliation consequences.
capabilities.nextAction: Trace order-to-cash and procure-to-pay through ledger evidence.

capabilities.name: Agriculture lifecycle journey

capabilities.nextAction: Prove plot-plan-finance-procure-operate-monitor-harvest-grade-store-sell-settle.

capabilities.name: Marketplace commerce journey
capabilities.outcome: Discovery through seller settlement is transactional, trustworthy and reversible.
capabilities.nextAction: Prove comparison, checkout, payment, fulfilment, return, refund and settlement.

capabilities.name: Insurance protection journey
capabilities.outcome: Need analysis through claim appeal is suitable, explainable and auditable.

capabilities.name: Rural finance and lending journey
capabilities.outcome: Eligibility through repayment and recovery uses consented, explainable underwriting.
capabilities.nextAction: Prove cash-flow assessment, sanction, disbursement, monitoring and dignified recovery.

capabilities.name: Suitability and comparison layer
capabilities.outcome: Offers are ranked by user-controlled criteria with exclusions, affordability and reasons.
capabilities.nextAction: Define sector-neutral comparison contract and regulated-sector adapters.

capabilities.name: Logistics control tower
capabilities.outcome: Load planning through settlement includes custody, ETA confidence and exception recovery.
capabilities.nextAction: Prove capacity match, tracking, cold-chain exception, delivery and settlement.

capabilities.name: Evidence Passport
capabilities.outcome: Important objects and decisions carry provenance, issuer, consent and verification status.
capabilities.nextAction: Define immutable evidence envelope and verification lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Digital grievance spine
capabilities.outcome: Complaints and appeals share acknowledgement, evidence, SLA, escalation and closure rules.
capabilities.nextAction: Implement cross-domain grievance state machine and regulator handoff adapters.

capabilities.name: Government scheme rules engine
capabilities.outcome: Effective-dated cited rules compute eligibility, evidence, application and appeal.
capabilities.nextAction: Convert priority schemes from content into executable versioned rules.

capabilities.name: Rural assisted and offline access

capabilities.nextAction: Prove queue, conflicts, resumable transfer, shared-device privacy and recovery.

capabilities.name: Engineering intelligence chain
capabilities.outcome: Calculations expose standards, assumptions, units, formula versions and professional approvals.
capabilities.nextAction: Trace one cold-storage project from inputs through design, BOQ, checking and commissioning.

capabilities.name: Governed adaptive experience

capabilities.name: Governed AI nervous system
capabilities.outcome: AI routing, retrieval, agents and memory are permission-aware, evaluated and human-governed.
capabilities.nextAction: Inventory models, prompts, tools and fabricated outputs; require decision passports.

capabilities.name: Trusted analytics and benefit ledger
capabilities.outcome: Metrics and recommendations connect verified source data to actual measured outcomes.

capabilities.name: Trust graph

capabilities.outcome: Pre-approved low-risk actions execute within explicit limits, oversight and reversal paths.
capabilities.nextAction: Define autonomy tiers, approval thresholds, kill switch and compensation contracts.

capabilities.name: Ethical personalization constitution

capabilities.nextAction: Codify prohibited inference, purpose limits, fairness tests and user controls.
